meta.name: mobile-design
meta.description: Mobile-first design thinking and decision-making for iOS and Android apps. Touch interaction, performance patterns, platform conventions. Teaches principles, not fixed values. Use when building React Native, Flutter, or native mobile apps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 指导移动端设计决策，优化交互与平台规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计iOS或Android应用，需要遵循平台规范。
copy.tagline_en: Guide mobile design decisions, optimize interaction and platform conventions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing iOS or Android apps and need to follow platform conventions.

howto.what: Claude 会按照移动端优先的原则设计 iOS 和 Android 应用，关注触摸交互、性能优化和平台规范。它会先要求你确认平台、框架等关键信息，然后参考专门的技能文件来给出建议，避免常见的移动端反模式。
howto.when: 当你提到要开发移动应用（如 React Native、Flutter 或原生应用），或者询问移动端设计、性能、触摸交互等问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 iOS 应用的登录页面，注意触摸区域大小。
React Native 列表性能优化有哪些要点？
Android 和 iOS 的导航模式有什么不同？
say.note: Claude 会对比平台差异，并建议如何统一或分化。

howto.what_en: Claude will design iOS and Android apps with a mobile-first mindset, focusing on touch interaction, performance, and platform conventions. It will ask for platform/framework details first, then reference skill files to give advice and avoid common anti-patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention building a mobile app (React Native, Flutter, or native), or ask about mobile design, performance, touch interaction, etc.

say_en.text: Design an iOS login page with proper touch targets.
say_en.note: Claude reads iOS platform file first, then gives HIG-compliant advice.

say_en.text: How to optimize list performance in React Native?
say_en.note: Claude references performance file for FlatList, memo, etc.

say_en.text: What are the navigation differences between Android and iOS?
say_en.note: Claude compares platform conventions and suggests unification or divergence.
